rules.statement: The High Court cannot set aside an arbitral award on grounds not specified in the Arbitration Act, and must make a finding based on the application and material contained therein.
rules.supporting_quote: A finding cannot be made by the High Court in terms of sub paragraph (b) of section 32 (1) other than on the averments of the application and the material contained therein.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 32 (1) of the Arbitration Act No. 11 of 1995
